title: rosa × dumetorum var. hispidula
intro: Rosa × dumetorum var. hispidula, commonly known as Rosa rugosa 'Hispidula', is a variety of shrub rose that is native to East Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rugosa 'Hispidula' include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
